narrative.overview: IsyaratKita combines approachable civic clarity with tactile translucent glass surfaces ("Liquid Glass"). Because the platform serves as a real-time bridge between Deaf/hard-of-hearing signers (Teman Tuli) and hearing speakers (Teman Dengar), every surface prioritizes immediate legibility, calm visual hierarchy, and unambiguous status feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Liquid Glass Surfaces: Translucent white layers paired with backdrop-filter blur and specular borders.
Single Humanist Sans-Serif: Geometric warmth and high legibility across all scales using Plus Jakarta Sans.
Dual-Modality Status Signaling: Cobalt blue anchors primary actions, while emerald mint signals active camera tracking and verified SIBI gestures.

rules.name: The Dual-Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve Civic Cobalt (#2563eb) for user-initiated controls and navigation, and reserve Signal Mint (#10b981) for live sensor readiness, verified hand tracking, and positive accuracy feedback.

rules.name: The Webcam-Distance Rule
rules.body: Never set active gesture readouts or live transcript text below 16px (1rem), ensuring a signer standing back from their camera can read detections without squinting.

rules.name: The Specular Edge Rule
rules.body: Every blurred glass surface must pair its translucent background with a 1px solid semi-opaque white or slate border so card boundaries remain crisp against white backgrounds.

dos: Do pair every audio/speech output control with a visible text transcript or status badge so Deaf and hearing users receive equivalent feedback.
Do use .liquid-glass and .liquid-glass-card classes with 1px borders to preserve depth on light backgrounds.
Do display clear anatomical finger instructions alongside SIBI letter and word cards.
donts: Don't place unbordered white cards directly on the #f8fafc–#ffffff background where boundaries disappear.
Don't rely on sound-only alerts or color-only error states without accompanying text and icons.
Don't clutter the camera viewport overlay; keep landmark skeleton lines and hold-progress bars clean and unobstructed.
